novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement relationship: LLMs "use [conceptual metaphors] as covert reasoning scaffolds," producing congruency-dependent accuracy and "predictable directional errors," with metaphor-neutral restatement reversing the impairment. Searches for "LLM conceptual metaphor congruency bias," "large language model MORE IS UP reasoning," "metaphor incongruent framing LLM," and "conceptual metaphor prompting reasoning" identify Kramer’s 2025 "Conceptual Metaphor Theory as a Prompting Paradigm for Large Language Models" as the closest LLM work, while human valence-space congruency studies such as Santiago et al. (2018), "Hand Position and Response Assignment Modulate the Activation of the Valence-Space Conceptual Metaphor," establish the underlying human phenomenon; neither supplies the claimed cross-metaphor directional-error and de-metaphorization relationship in LLM reasoning. The step is therefore a substantive natural extension and systematic operationalization of known human congruency effects plus metaphor-based LLM prompting, rather than a wholly new core paradigm, supporting standard rather than high novelty.
